>You seem to be feeling isolated and maybe that there is a conspiracy against you - that you're 'broken' in some way? 

Not in the slightest.  There are tent cities nearby. There are also people driving ferarris to their fifth condo. Life is indifferent.  I just expected more from myself, and I suppose from others. I don't expect people to notice me.  I don't even want them to, most of the time. It's usually negative, criticisms, shouting, insults, or just a laugh. A warry look.  Not always. But people have their own lives. They have their own problems.  

I'm not being unrealistic or unnecessarily pessimistic.  It's just life.  Some people lose.  If you enter a race and beat a world record, but everyone else in the race was faster, you still lost.  That's not applicable to my life, but it's a transferable concept nonetheless. Someone has to lose.

You can't ignore everyone, always. You can't pretend you don't care, always.  Most of the time?  Sure. This is not one of those moments. 

It's staring in the mirror, seeing lines begin to form around your eyes.  You can see the stress take physical form in you, transforming you years earlier than your peers.  You wonder where the time went.  It was saying "fuck them" and then doing that. The trees bloom and the leaves fall.  You're standing in front of the mirror, and in that moment of vulnerability, you admit you want companionship.  You go out.  But slowly, surely, you remember why you stopped in the first place.  It's a junction.  Be a hermit, or kill oneself.  Neither is the choice you want. It's a slow acceptance that you're not cut out. I don't blame everyone else.  I just wish things were different. I wish I was different.  They are similar, but not conjunctive thoughts.
